verdict.rationale: Morph's docs publish concrete speed figures: Fast Apply at 10,500 tok/s, Compact at 33,000 tok/s, and Reflex classifiers at about 90ms per turn. These are headline numbers only, with no methodology, benchmark reports or load-testing guidance, and the GitHub demos cite a different 4,500+ tokens/sec figure. Missing for 10: benchmark methodology or reproducible results, load-testing guides, latency percentiles, independent corroboration of the throughput claims.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can see published tokens-per-second or latency numbers, benchmarks, or load-testing guides backing the provider's speed claims

citations.quote: Fast Apply merges just the changed lines at 10,500 tok/s, 98% accuracy.
Drop filler from chat history and code context at 33,000 tok/s.
Small text classifiers that label a turn in ~90ms
Use Morph's API to intelligently modify existing code at 4,500+ tokens/sec
